name: English - Poetry and Design C1
description:
As TUM students, many of you are engaged in design on a daily basis, whether writing program code, rethinking how traffic moves through a city (or a package around the world), designing new lab set-ups, or constructing an engine. This course introduces you to poets who do something similar with language -- and shows how their work can enhance yours. 

Over three months, we will read and analyze 12-20 poems in English, spanning more than four centuries, and look at how each might deepen or expand our understanding of design principles from fields across the TUM academic landscape. Our weekly 90-minute sessions will involve short presentations in which the poems' form, historical context, and interpretations are introduced, as well as group discussion, writing exercises, guest lectures, and recitations.
prerequisites: Students need not have any experience with poetry.
